subject.title: feat: Discord channel-per-agent binding display in Gateway UI (ZZ-20260311-005)

question: Which Gateway/UI surface should own read-only configured route and ACP binding visibility for the Agents channels panel?
rationale: The requested work adds a new core Gateway protocol method and a Control UI read model, and current main already has both raw config access and binding helpers, so the permanent API namespace is a maintainer product/API choice.

options.title: Approve a normalized binding read model
options.body: Define a stable read-only list contract, whether named routing.list or placed under an existing namespace, then review the linked implementation against that contract.

options.title: Use existing config data
options.body: Have the UI derive the display from config.get and current config helpers, accepting tighter coupling to raw config shape but avoiding a new RPC namespace.

options.title: Defer the display
options.body: Keep bindings visible through docs/config for now and pause or close the implementation PR until a broader Control UI routing plan exists.

recommendation.title: Approve a normalized binding read model
recommendation.body: Define a stable read-only list contract, whether named routing.list or placed under an existing namespace, then review the linked implementation against that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans core Gateway method policy and Control UI product shape, and steipete is the strongest recent history signal on Gateway RPC surface changes.
